source_dataset_license: CC BY as shown on AACR Figshare item page; verify attribution before reuse

cohort.stages: pretreatment and end-of-therapy only in this supplement; not equally spaced longitudinal series

data_rules.dash_and_unlisted: not reported in supplement; not treated as confirmed assay-negative
data_rules.vaf: numeric values only; no zero imputation
data_rules.patient_blocking: one row per patient; repeated variants summarized per patient

primary_cross_moa_question.question: Is a pretreatment TP53 variant listed more often among patients with a newly listed KRAS G12C copy-number gain/amplification at end of adagrasib/sotorasib therapy?
primary_cross_moa_question.interpretation: cross-MOA exploratory comparison; rows absent from the supplement are not confirmed negative assays; does not establish TP53 causality or a treatment recommendation

controls.name: treatment
controls.description: adagrasib vs sotorasib; distinct KRAS G12C inhibitor mechanism cohort

controls.name: best_response
controls.description: best response in source table; PD denotes primary resistance

controls.name: tp53_baseline_variant_listed
controls.description: TP53 variant with numeric pretreatment VAF listed; absence is not called WT

controls.name: baseline_kras_g12c_detection
controls.description: whether numeric pretreatment KRAS G12C VAF appears in supplement

controls.name: baseline_kras_g12c_vaf_pct
controls.description: pretreatment KRAS G12C VAF percentage; numeric rows only

controls.name: technology_profile
controls.description: assay platform(s) listed per patient; exploratory, sparse levels

flows.name: new_kras_cn_amp_listed
flows.description: KRAS copy-number Amp listed as absent pretreatment and Amp at end of therapy

flows.name: new_kras_cn_gain_or_amp_listed
flows.description: KRAS copy-number Gain/Amp listed as absent pretreatment and present at end of therapy

flows.name: new_any_cn_listed
flows.description: any copy-number Gain/Amp row listed as new

flows.name: new_any_mutation_listed
flows.description: any mutation row absent in pretreatment listing and numeric at end of therapy

flows.name: new_any_event_listed
flows.description: any newly listed mutation or copy-number event

flows.name: new_ras_pi3k_rtk_mutation_listed
flows.description: newly listed mutation in prespecified RAS/MAPK/PI3K/RTK gene set

flows.name: n_new_mutation_rows_listed
flows.description: count of newly listed mutation rows; not a variant burden estimate

flows.name: n_new_copy_number_rows_listed
flows.description: count of newly listed copy-number rows

flows.name: eot_kras_g12c_vaf_pct
flows.description: end-of-therapy KRAS G12C VAF percentage; numeric rows only

flows.name: delta_kras_g12c_vaf_pp
flows.description: end-of-therapy minus pretreatment VAF percentage points; both numeric only

statistics.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg over all estimable control x flow tests

scope: typed multiaxis companion only; not universal-core/TLog validation; no T0; no causal or clinical-treatment claim
